evidence.detail: The central initialization method constructs roughly ninety rs/n/c/* custom interface-builder instances, passing the shared font array where required, and routes every builder through the same registration helper.
The registration helper invokes rs/n/c.a() to build each custom interface and retains the builder in a shared List<rs/n/c> only when its c() predicate is true.

R56 already identifies rs/n/e as RSInterface, the core decoded widget/interface object. rs/n/d finishes its custom-builder pass by handing the font array into the RSInterface base setup rather than replacing that core loader.

Stable lineage places rs/n/d at CLIENT_CLASS_000680 immediately before R284 InterfaceRelativeLayoutConstraint, InterfaceLayoutEntry and InterfaceLayoutManager (000681-000683), with RSInterface at 000684, fixing this class in the custom-interface construction/registration layer.

proposals.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name for the central registry/initialization pass over custom rs/n/c/* interface builders. It is not the core archive-decoded RSInterface loader.
